description: Find the process ID of a running program.

option.name: -c
tip: Only return processes with the same root directory.

option.name: -d
tip: Use sep as the output separator.

option.name: -n
tip: Avoid stat on binaries on network file systems.

option.name: -o
tip: Omit the process with this PID.

option.name: -q
tip: Do not display matched PIDs; only set the exit status.

option.name: -x
tip: Also return shells running the named scripts.

option.name: -z
tip: Also detect processes stuck in zombie state.
